title: fix(service-analytics)!: the dataset query door refuses measures and dimensions the dataset does not declare
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbKnsd8ZLsq9hBbRRm5JvJb2)_

Fixes #34005

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up #34328 — `skills/**` teach dataset selections by the dataset's declared measures and dimensions (objectstack-ui: a report selects `rows` and `values` "from that dataset"), which the door now enforces; they do not yet say that a compare widget's date key must be the name of a declared date dimension, and that teaching is carried by #34328; `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx` and `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx` state the rule in this change.

> [!WARNING]
> **BREAKING** for a caller of `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query` (and each entry of `/analytics/dataset/query/batch`), or of `AnalyticsService.queryDataset` in process, that names a measure or dimension the dataset does not declare. That selection used to be answered with a member minted on the fly; it is now refused `400 INVALID_FIELD`, the same refusal the AI tool `query_dataset` gives. ADR-0087 disposition (in the changeset, one marker): `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, because a runtime request refusal changes the shape of no metadata key, value or stored row. Authored dashboards, reports and charts are save-gated to declared members in their measures and dimensions, but one class is not: a dashboard compare widget whose date-range field is not also the name of a declared dimension passes every save and publish check and is refused after this change. When the date-range field is a field of the dataset's own object, the refusal names the remedy: declare a date dimension named after the date-range field (seat re-ruling 6909938292 on #34005 (question 4, M1 option a)). When it is a related record's dotted field (`account.signed_at`), which the dataset query used to answer through the dataset's `include`, this is a break with no in-dataset remedy: no dimension name can carry a dot, so the refusal names no declaration for that key and says the comparison needs a date field of the dataset's own object that a declared date dimension names (seat ruling 6911721875 on #34005 (L2 M1, dotted date key, option A)). The renderer mapping a dotted date key onto a declared dimension over that path is carried by #34350. The missing save gate is #34308; the skills teaching for the compare widget's date key is #34328.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:数据集查询入口(REST 单查与批量、服务内 `queryDataset`)现在只接受数据集自己声明的度量和维度,与 AI 工具 `query_dataset` 共用同一条判定。
- 为什么改:以前入口会临时造指标(`count`、把原始字段当 `sum`、`_sum` 后缀、`数据集名.` 前缀、原始字段当维度),看板上可能出现一个数据集从没定义过的「指标」,并且两个入口对同一个名字给出不同答案。
- 风险与回滚:直接调 API 并且用未声明成员的调用方会收到 400。另有一类没有保存校验兜住:看板的对比(compareTo)组件,如果看板日期范围字段不是数据集里某个已声明维度的名字,现在会被拒绝:日期范围字段是数据集本对象字段时,报错文案给出修法(声明一个与之同名的日期维度);是关联记录的点号字段(如 `account.signed_at`)时,没有数据集内的修法,文案只说明对比需要本对象的日期字段,渲染端映射由 #34350 承接;补保存校验的卡是 #34308,技能文档补教的卡是 #34328。按名字普查了官方示例和 hotcrm 的看板与报表,命中为 0。回滚方式是 revert 本 PR(改动只在 service-analytics、测试和文档里)。
- 先看:`packages/services/service-analytics/src/analytics-service.ts` 里的 `assertSelectionMembersDeclared`(拒绝点和 403 先于成员清单的顺序),`src/dataset-declared-members.ts`(共用判定),`src/dataset-tools.ts`(AI 入口改为复用)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/__tests__/dataset-query-declared-members.test.ts`,预期全绿;拒绝用例断言 `INVALID_FIELD`/400、`member`/`param`/`cube`,以及「可用成员」清单。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

- **One rule, two faces.** The new file `src/dataset-declared-members.ts` holds `undeclaredSelectionMembers`. It judges `selection.measures`, `selection.dimensions` and each `timeDimensions[].dimension` against the dataset's own `measures[].name` / `dimensions[].name`, spelled exactly. The AI tool's `assertDeclaredMembers` (`dataset-tools.ts`, from PR #33958) now calls it, so the judgment is lifted, not forked. Each face words its own next step: the AI face falls back to the object query tools, and the door tells an author to declare the member.
- **The door.** `AnalyticsService.answerDataset` calls `assertSelectionMembersDeclared` right after compiling the dataset, before anything is read. Order of answers:
  - A missing dataset is still `404 NOT_FOUND`, first.
  - A caller who may not read the dataset's object still gets the read refusal (`403`), never a member list.
  - Otherwise the answer is `400 INVALID_FIELD`. Over REST the body is `{ code, message }`; in process the thrown error also carries `member`, `param` and `cube` from the first undeclared entry. The message names every undeclared member, the measures and dimensions THIS caller may use (never a withheld member, and never one over an `internal` field, per ADR-0100), and the remedy.
- **Unchanged.** A declared member over a field the caller may not read still reaches the field gate (`403 PERMISSION_DENIED`). `runtimeFilter` keys are fields and are judged as before. The cube door `POST /analytics/query` is not a dataset and keeps its ad-hoc members.
- **Source-field remedy on the dataset door (5a127a4cc9).** A dataset reaches the measure and dimension source-field gates only through a DECLARED member whose field the object does not have; an undeclared one is refused first. Those gates ended with the cube door's hint (measures are inferred from the object's own fields as `FIELD_sum`…, and any own field may be used as a dimension without declaring it), which is false on the dataset door. A dataset call's scope now carries `datasetDoor`, which `ensureCube` and the draft preview pass to both gates. On the dataset door the refusal says "The dataset declares this measure/dimension over 'FIELD': point its `field` at one of the object's fields, or remove the measure/dimension". The cube door's message is byte-identical. The changeset notes it (e2a0a9c205).
- **Inline datasets.** An inline `dataset` body is judged against its own `measures` and `dimensions`.
- **Docs.** `content/docs/data-modeling/analytics.mdx` states the rule beside the body-key paragraph. `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx` no longer says the analytics query API accepts an object's own field as an ad-hoc dimension: the dataset query answers declared members only, and only the cube query (`POST /analytics/query`) still groups by an undeclared field. A new section, "The Date Key of a Compare Widget", says a compare widget's date key is the date-range field's name and must be the name of a declared date dimension, with the remedy, and (fix round 4) that a related record's dotted date field has no in-dataset remedy. The spec TSDoc on the dashboard global filter's `field` (`packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts`) says the same old thing and is outside this PR's surface: card #34307.
- **Compare-window remedy (seat re-ruling 6909938292 on #34005 (question 4, M1 option a)).** The refusal stays. When the refused member is a comparison window's date key (a `timeDimensions` entry carrying a `dateRange` in a selection with `compareTo`, which is how a dashboard compare widget sends its date-range field), the message adds: the dimension is the date key of the comparison window; declare a date dimension named after it on the dataset (over that field). That is the only remedy it names, and only for a key that can be a dimension name (fix round 4: a key the dimension-name schema refuses, such as a dotted `relationship.field`, gets the own-object requirement instead). With two or more such keys it names them together, in the plural. `compareWindowRemedy` in `dataset-declared-members.ts`; the AI tool's wording is unchanged. The generic select-or-declare sentence ("Use one of these, or declare the member on the dataset … and query it by that name") covers only members it can fix (fix round 4 completion): it is left out when every undeclared member is such an unnameable key, and it names the members it is for when only some are.
- **Draft-preview comments.** The #28172 / #28201 comments at the draft-preview gates in `analytics-service.ts` now note that selection members never reach that branch (refused earlier by `assertSelectionMembersDeclared`).
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/34005-dataset-door-declared-members.md` is a `patch` (Metadata-protocol `none`) with the BREAKING paragraph and the ADR-0087 disposition. Both now name the compare-widget class and its remedy, and the BREAKING paragraph says the refusal names that remedy in its message.

## Tests

- **New: `src/__tests__/dataset-query-declared-members.test.ts`** (real `AnalyticsServicePlugin`, security double).
  - Seven refusal cases: `count`, a raw field, a suffix spelling, a `DATASET.`-qualified spelling, an undeclared measure beside a declared one, a raw dimension, and a raw time dimension. Each asserts `code`, `status`, `member`, `param`, `cube`, the declared-member list and the remedy, and checks that nothing was read.
  - The refusal names only caller-usable members.
  - An inline dataset is judged against its own declaration.
  - Controls: an unreadable object answers 403 with no member list; a declared but forbidden member answers 403; declared members are served; the cube door still mints `count`.
- **New: `packages/qa/dogfood/test/analytics-dataset-declared-members.dogfood.test.ts`** (stock showcase, real HTTP stack).
  - Six refusal cases on `showcase_task_metrics`.
  - The batch door refuses one entry and serves its declared sibling.
  - Controls: declared members are served, and a missing dataset is still 404.
- **Triaged pins.** These pinned the minting this PR removes. Each was re-judged, not batch-respelled:
  - `preview-undeclared-measure-parity` and `preview-undeclared-dimension-parity`: every spelling now gets the closed-member refusal; the declared controls are kept.
  - `query-dataset-request-scope`, `dataset-drill-scopes`, `dimension-source-field-gate` and `dotted-path-preview-parity`: the undeclared spellings are now refusals; the `runtimeFilter` and declared-member pins are kept.
  - `dotted-dimension-unbacked-join-parity`: the case list was extended. The backed-join CONTROLs that passed only because a raw path was minted were removed.
  - `preview-filter-field-json-dimension-parity`: now selects the declared `payload_dim`.
  - `preview-time-filter-fk-parity`: the fixture now declares `closed_on`, `account_id`, `account_name` and `account_ref`, and the FK pins select those names. A declared lookup dimension resolves display labels, so the expected rows are `'Acme'`/`'Globex'`. The raw spellings are a new refusal row.

- **Rest pins moved (d9106e8c03).** Four `@objectstack/rest` pins selected members their dataset never declared, so they now meet the closed-member refusal before the gate they pin:
  - `analytics-dataset-dimension-gate`: the source-field gate (`groups by field 'bogus_dim'`, and `buckets field` for the time dimension) is reached through a stale declared dimension. The raw-field leg (`phone`, `bogus_dim`) is its own closed-member pin. The positive control stays 200 and groups a declared `phone_dim`.
  - `analytics-dataset-refusal-envelope`: the include positive control stays 200 and reads `account.region` through a declared `account_region`.
  - `analytics-dataset-unlisted-refusal-envelope`: `profit_sum` is refused as undeclared. A stale declared `profit_total` keeps the `aggregates field 'profit'` assertion.
  - `analytics-relationship-path-admission`: the declared-join reference stays 403. The undeclared path member is refused 400 before any read; the dataset's own objects are readable, so the read 403 does not apply.
- **Test-source alias (8e358c311d).** `analytics-dataset-dimension-gate` and `analytics-dataset-refusal-envelope` now import `@objectstack/objectql` at module top, so its first load is paid at collection rather than inside a clocked window. `pnpm check:test-source-alias`: exit 0.
- **Docs (b25fa01d87).** The `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx` "How to spell a measure" callout now says that the inferred spellings belong to the cube query only, and that the dataset query refuses any undeclared name `400 INVALID_FIELD`.
- **Remedy pins (5a127a4cc9).** `dataset-query-declared-members.test.ts` pins both directions: a stale declared measure and a stale declared dimension on the dataset door name the declared field and the fix and carry no inferred-member hint, while the cube door (`query()`) keeps both hints. `preview-undeclared-measure-parity` pins the same dataset-door message on the native, ObjectQL and draft-preview faces. The rest stale-declaration pins (`analytics-dataset-dimension-gate`, `analytics-dataset-unlisted-refusal-envelope`) assert the dataset-door remedy and the absence of the hint end to end.
- **Fix round 2 (review 6908009392).**
  - Compare-window remedy: `dataset-query-declared-members.test.ts` pins the message for an undeclared `closed_on` window with `compareTo` (`member`/`param`/`cube`, the date-key sentence and the remedy; fix round 3 below narrows the remedy pin), plus a control that the same undeclared time dimension without `compareTo` gets no compare-widget sentence.
  - Refusal order against the read gate, in process: beside the existing denial pin, a caller the read gate cannot decide for (its lookup throws) gets `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` with no member list and nothing read.
  - Through the REST door (`packages/rest/src/analytics-read-gate-fault-envelope.test.ts`, the real service): an undeclared selection answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` for a denied caller and `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` for an undecidable one, both with no member list and nothing executed; the admitted control answers `400 INVALID_FIELD` with "Measures you may use: revenue.". The file now imports `@objectstack/objectql` at module top (`pnpm check:test-source-alias`).
  - `dotted-dimension-unbacked-join-parity`: the served control is back as a DECLARED dimension over the backed path (`account_name` reads `account.name`): both live strategies return Acme 130 / Globex 50, and the draft preview keeps its own refusal.
- **Verification on 43b494b872 (fix round 2).**
  - Local tests and the closure build are NOT MEASURED, reason: the shared verify lock was never acquired in seven attempts (each `VERDICT queue-timeout (exit 99)`, about 65 minutes in all, behind sibling runs). The PR's own CI on this head carries them: `Test Core` (8/8 shards) success, with `dataset-query-declared-members.test.ts` (19 tests), `dotted-dimension-unbacked-join-parity.test.ts` (29 tests) and `analytics-read-gate-fault-envelope.test.ts` (10 tests) each passing in the shard logs; `TypeScript Type Check` success; `Lint & Repo Gates` success; `Build Core` success; `Dogfood Regression Gate` success; `Check Changeset` success.

- **Ablation of the flag.** One mutation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`: `datasetDoor: compiled !== undefined` → `datasetDoor: false` (blob 74714b8ca72c → 684ea485151b). Baseline 27/27; mutated 3 failed, 24 passed (the two dataset-door pins and the preview-face pin; the cube-door control stays green); restored blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty. A first attempt ran before the workspace build and failed at collection (`Cannot find package '@objectstack/spec/ui'`, no tests run): a no-op, discarded and re-run after the build.

## Fix round 3 (review 6909901648)

Ruling: seat re-ruling 6909938292 on #34005 (question 4, M1 option a). Head `75e3e0618c`, after merging `origin/main` at `7917a19e54` (16 commits behind; the merge touches no file of this PR).

- **M1.** The refusal, the dashboards page ("The Date Key of a Compare Widget"), the changeset's BREAKING bullet and the ADR-0087 marker now name one remedy: declare a date dimension named after the date-range field. The class they describe no longer carries a `compareTo` qualification. `compareWindowRemedy` (`dataset-declared-members.ts`); the `compareTo` table row on the page did not repeat the remedy and is unchanged.
- **M1 pin.** New case in `dataset-query-declared-members.test.ts`: `compareTo` names the declared `close_month`, and a second dated `timeDimensions` entry names the undeclared `closed_on`. It asserts `INVALID_FIELD`/400 with `member: 'closed_on'`, the date-key sentence, the one remedy, that the message does not contain `compareTo.dimension`, and that nothing was read. The existing compare-window pin now asserts the same absence.
- **N2.** The plural arm reads "The dimensions "closed_on" and "created_at" are the date keys …" and "Declare a date dimension for each on the dataset, named "closed_on" and "created_at", each over the field of the same name." New pin for it. The singular sentence is unchanged apart from the dropped remedy.
- **S2.** `Skills-docs:` in this body and in the changeset now cites follow-up #34328: the skills teach declared measures and dimensions, and the compare widget's date key is carried by #34328.
- **N1.** Card #34308 was corrected by comment; cited as before.

## Fix round 4 (review 6911685604)

Ruling: seat ruling 6911721875 on #34005 (L2 M1, dotted date key, option A). The refusal stays; no executor behaviour change. Head `d782833df3`; 4 commits behind `origin/main`, not merged.

- **M1, message.** `compareWindowRemedy` (`dataset-declared-members.ts`) decides per key whether it can be a dimension name with the dataset schema's own `SnakeCaseIdentifierSchema` (no hand-rolled pattern). A key that cannot (a dotted `relationship.field`, or any key the grammar refuses) gets no "declare a date dimension named" sentence; the message says it cannot be a dimension name, so no date dimension can be declared under it, and that the comparison cannot run on a dataset query unless the dashboard's date field is a field of the dataset's own object that a declared date dimension names. A nameable key keeps the existing remedy, byte-identical. Mixed keys get one sentence per kind, the declare-it one scoped "For the key(s) that can be a dimension name(s)".
- **M1, prose.** The dashboards page ("The Date Key of a Compare Widget" and the `compareTo` table row), the changeset's BREAKING bullet and the ADR-0087 marker state the dotted class as a break with no in-dataset remedy. The changeset cites #34350 for the renderer mapping; the docs page cites no card.
- **M1, pins.** `dotted-path-preview-parity.test.ts` replaces the removed served control: a compare window over the backed `account.founded_at` is refused `INVALID_FIELD`/400 alike on every face, the message names no "declare a date dimension named" remedy, and it names the own-object requirement. `dataset-query-declared-members.test.ts` pins one mixed plural case through the service, plus a grammar table over every combination the function produces (1 or 2 nameable, 1 or 2 unnameable, a non-dotted grammar failure, two mixes).
- **Completed in "Fix round 4 (completion)" below:** the ablation, the full `service-analytics` suite, `typecheck`, the derived gates, and the dotted-only message.

## Fix round 4 (completion)

Takeover of the handed-off round (hand-off 6912068262) by `repo:objectstack#1`, under seat ruling 6911721875 on #34005 (dotted compare-window date key, option A). Code commit `7a6aa7d0ed`; final head `29a15c032b`, a merge of `origin/main` at `d01f399e3b` taken because sibling PR #34335 landed with its own edit of `content/docs/ui/dashboards.mdx` (its native-SQL paragraph under "Filtering on a Related Record's Field"). The merge applied without conflicts and keeps both edits; the PR's own diff is still the same 23 files. CI on the handed-off head `d782833df3` was green: 53 checks, 36 success, 17 skipped, none failed or pending.

- **The open point, measured.** On `d782833df3`, a compare window whose only undeclared member is a dotted key read: "… Dimensions you may use: region. Use one of these, or declare the member on the dataset (its `measures` or `dimensions`) and query it by that name. The dimension "account.founded_at" is the date key … "account.founded_at" cannot be a dimension name …, so no date dimension can be declared under it: …". The first sentence tells the author to declare the one member, the dotted key, under its name; the ruling says the refusal does not tell the author that. With an undeclared measure beside the dotted key, "declare the member" covered both members alike.
- **Fix.** `undeclaredMembersRefusal` (`dataset-declared-members.ts`) builds the select-or-declare sentence only for members it can fix: a compare-window date key that the dimension-name grammar refuses is never one. When every undeclared member is such a key, the sentence is left out and the compare-window sentence is the whole remedy. When some are, it reads "For the measure "amount_sum", use one of these, or declare the member on the dataset …". When none are, it is byte-identical to before. Unchanged: which members are refused, `INVALID_FIELD`/400, `member`/`param`/`cube`, and `compareWindowRemedy` (the nameable-key text included). The changeset's general bullet and the dashboards page say the dotted key gets no declaration.
- **Pins.** `dataset-query-declared-members.test.ts`: a dotted key as the only undeclared member (the message goes straight from "Dimensions you may use: …" to the date-key sentence, names no declaration, and carries the ruling's sentence in full), a dotted key beside an undeclared measure (the sentence names the measure only), and the existing nameable-plus-dotted case now asserts its scoped sentence. `dotted-path-preview-parity.test.ts`: the dotted compare-window pin asserts the absence of the generic sentence on every face.
